title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: A banker serving a life sentence for a crime he insists he didn't commit forms an unlikely friendship and quietly plans for a future beyond prison walls.
admin_review: A patient, deeply humane story about hope and friendship. Flawless performances and an ending that earns every bit of its emotion.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman, Commissioner Gordon and a new district attorney take on organised crime in Gotham, until an anarchic criminal known as the Joker pushes the city to the brink.
admin_review: The gold standard for superhero cinema: tense, thematically rich, and anchored by an unforgettable villain performance.

title: Inception
overview: A thief who steals secrets from inside dreams is offered a chance at redemption: plant an idea in a target's mind instead of taking one.
admin_review: An inventive heist puzzle with spectacular set pieces. Occasionally exposition-heavy, but thrilling and original throughout.

title: Interstellar
overview: With Earth failing, a former pilot joins a mission through a wormhole to find humanity a new home, leaving his children behind.
admin_review: Ambitious and emotionally sweeping. The science gets hand-wavy near the end, but the scale and heart are remarkable.

title: The Matrix
overview: A hacker discovers that the world he knows is a simulation and joins a rebellion against the machines that built it.
admin_review: Genre-defining action and big ideas delivered with style. Its influence on modern blockbusters is impossible to overstate.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: Interlocking stories of two hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner robbers collide in Los Angeles.
admin_review: Razor-sharp dialogue and a playful non-linear structure make this endlessly rewatchable, though its violence won't suit everyone.

title: Forrest Gump
overview: A kind-hearted man with a simple outlook drifts through decades of American history while never letting go of his childhood love.
admin_review: Warm and charming with a memorable lead performance, if sometimes a little too sentimental.

title: Parasite
overview: A struggling family schemes its way into the employ of a wealthy household, until a hidden secret upends everything.
admin_review: A masterful blend of dark comedy, social satire and suspense. Every twist lands; a modern classic.

title: Avengers: Endgame
overview: After a devastating loss, the remaining Avengers assemble one last time to undo the damage and restore balance to the universe.
admin_review: A crowd-pleasing finale with huge payoffs for long-time fans, though it is bloated and leans heavily on prior films.

title: Joker
overview: A failed comedian on the margins of Gotham society spirals into violence and becomes an unlikely symbol of unrest.
admin_review: A committed central performance carries a bleak story that feels derivative of better films. Unsettling, but uneven.

title: Dune
overview: The heir of a noble house is thrust into a deadly war over a desert planet that holds the most valuable resource in the galaxy.
admin_review: Monumental world-building, stunning visuals and a thunderous score. It ends abruptly, but it's a triumph of big-screen spectacle.

title: Oppenheimer
overview: The story of the physicist who led the Manhattan Project, and the political fallout that followed the birth of the atomic bomb.

title: Whiplash
overview: An ambitious young jazz drummer is pushed to his limits by a ruthless conservatory instructor.
admin_review: Electrifying from the first beat to the last. Two ferocious performances and editing as precise as a drum solo.

title: La La Land
overview: An aspiring actress and a jazz pianist fall in love in Los Angeles while chasing dreams that may pull them apart.
admin_review: A gorgeous, bittersweet love letter to dreamers with a genuinely great final sequence.

title: Get Out
overview: A young man's weekend visit to his girlfriend's family estate turns increasingly sinister.
admin_review: Smart, funny and genuinely scary. A razor-sharp social thriller that rewards a second viewing.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
overview: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a drifter and a rebel commander flee a warlord across the desert in a war rig.
admin_review: Two hours of relentless, beautifully choreographed chaos. Practical action filmmaking at its absolute peak.

title: The Social Network
overview: A Harvard student builds a social networking site that makes him a billionaire and costs him his closest friendships.
admin_review: Crackling script and sharp direction turn a story about code and lawsuits into a gripping modern tragedy.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
overview: An overwhelmed laundromat owner must connect with versions of herself across the multiverse to save the world and her family.

title: Spirited Away
overview: A young girl wanders into a world of spirits and must work in a bathhouse for the gods to free herself and her parents.
admin_review: Enchanting, strange and endlessly imaginative. Hand-drawn animation doesn't get better than this.

title: Blade Runner 2049
overview: A new blade runner uncovers a long-buried secret that could plunge what's left of society into chaos.
admin_review: Breathtaking cinematography and a haunting atmosphere. Slow and long, but a worthy, thoughtful sequel.

title: Arrival
overview: A linguist is recruited to communicate with mysterious extraterrestrial visitors before global tensions boil over.
admin_review: Cerebral, moving science fiction with a twist that reframes the whole film. Quietly brilliant.

title: Coco
overview: A boy who dreams of becoming a musician journeys into the Land of the Dead to uncover his family's history.
admin_review: Vibrant, heartfelt and beautifully animated. Bring tissues for the finale.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
overview: Teenager Miles Morales becomes Spider-Man and teams up with spider-heroes from other dimensions to save every reality.

title: Gladiator
overview: A betrayed Roman general is sold into slavery and fights his way through the arena to take revenge on a corrupt emperor.
admin_review: Rousing old-school epic filmmaking with a commanding lead. Some historical liberties, but hugely entertaining.
